text: A Heroic Potion gives a short-lived boost of strength and health.

Heroic: Hodir's Sigil and its Normal mode equivalent Hodir's Sigil are a portion of the third step in the Algalon the Observer attunement quest chain. Completing this quest requires the defeat of Hodir in his Hard mode: Defeating him before he destroys the Rare Cache of Winter.
The Heroic Celestial Planetarium Key is a quest reward from Heroic: Algalon.

Heroic Leap is a tier 4 warrior class talent that causes the warrior to leap at a target, dealing damage to all enemies in the area upon landing. For Protection warriors it also reset the cooldown Taunt (warrior ability).
Heroic: The Twilight Destroyer (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Halion in the Ruby Sanctum on 10-player Heroic mode.
Heroic: Un'gol Ruins is a island expedition achievement earned for achieving victory in an expedition to Un'gol Ruins on Heroic difficulty or higher.

Hertz Locker is a feat of strength achievement earned by defeating all bosses in Operation: Mechagon within a single lockout, and preventing the destruction of all non-robotic life on Azeroth without any player dying on Mythic difficulty.
Heroic Edition: Ensorcelled Everwyrm is a feats of strength achievement earned for purchasing the Collector's Edition, Heroic Edition, or Epic Edition to obtain the Ensorcelled Everwyrm mount.
Heroic: Fate of Nathria is a feat of strength earned by defeating all bosses in Castle Nathria on heroic difficulty while it is a Fated Raid during Shadowlands Season 4.
Heroic: Fate of Domination is a feat of strength earned by defeating all bosses on Heroic difficulty while Sanctum of Domination is a Fated Raid during Shadowlands Season 4.
Heroic: Fate of the Sepulcher is a feat of strength earned by defeating all bosses on Heroic difficulty while Sepulcher of the First Ones is a Fated Raid.
Heroic: Fates of the Shadowlands Raids is a feat of strength earned by completing all three Fated Raids on Heroic difficulty in Shadowlands Season 4.
Herupitat is a tuskarr located in Iskaara in the Azure Span. He is flying kites with Paera Finebreeze and Terrath Windchaser.
Heroic Edition: Tangled Dreamweaver is a feat of strength that is earned for obtaining the Tangled Dreamweaver mount.

Those just beginning to follow the path of the shaman are tasked with finding this secret route through the mountains that border the Valley of Trials. Aside from providing shaman with access to the mystical Spirit Rock, the Hidden Path provides a good view of the Barrens from its highest point. There is also a low point that can be used to get to Ratchet or Orgrimmar, and could be used by Alliance to get into the Valley of Trials. [http://www.wegame.com/watch/hidden_path/?ref=uv Video tutorial on how to reach the Hidden Path]
Hi-Explosive Bomb is a powerful bomb created by Engineers that cause AoE fire damage and stun.

The Hidden Grove is a forested crater in northeastern Winterspring. The grove is surrounded on all sides by high cliffs and is virtually inaccessible. There is one entrance through a cave on the southeastern face of the ridge at . Dropping down from the top is also possible in some places, albeit very dangerous. The grove is home to many moonkin who are extremely hostile, and so most adventurers don't attempt to enter the glade.

Hgarth is an orc artisan enchanting trainer located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. His location is a bit hard to find, as he resides on a cliff above the town. Access to the cliff is via a narrow and steep path running from a nook just east-northeast of the largest tent.
Hibernation Crystal is an epic trinket used to phenomenally boost spell power for a short time.
Hexed Bracers are a quest reward from Jin'Zil's Forest Magic.
High Exarch Commodus was a draenei of the Aldor located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
Hexed Trolls are jungle trolls found on the Echo Isles in Durotar. As their name implies they are actually Darkspear trolls that have been enslaved by Zalazane's power.
Hidden Strongboxes are located around Dalaran in Alterac Mountains. A Rune of Opening was needed to open one.

Which variation of this quest you get depends on which variation of Of Traitors and Treason you accepted. Upon accepting this quest, the player will be offered a chat to fly to Wintergarde Keep, the location of the quest turn-in. If you take this chat, and you are shapeshifted, you will get the error "You can't take a taxi while shapeshifted!". If you take this chat, and you are mounted, you will give the error "You are already mounted! Dismount first." Just undo the shapeshift/dismount, and retry the chat.

Hierophant Liandra can be found at the western end of The Abandoned Reach just to the east of Farshire down on the beach. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she briefly appears in the Dreamgrove.

__NOTOC__ Hierophant Malyk is a worgen quest giver located at Farwatcher's Glen in the Stonetalon Mountains. Despite telling the gnome Salsbury the "Help" multiple times that he can't teach him how to turn into a worgen, the gnome still incorrectly believes that he would if he manages to gain his trust.
High Fiber is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Hidden Clutch is a small area in the mountains directly north of New Kargath in the Badlands. It has a small cave and a handful of patrolling Rock Elementals.
Hexweaver Akara is the leader of the harpies who have invaded the Screeching Crag in Highmountain. She summons Bound Prowlers.

The Hidden is a dark organization affiliated with the Burning Legion that is under the command of Malus's leader, the nathrezim Xaraax. They are described as a deadly band of raiders. Captain Malus was tasked with finding a magical compass once under the protection of Captain Greydon Thorne, and later placed on his son Aramar. Although Malus leads the Hidden, he, too, answers to a dreadlord master, Xaraax, but has a different plan with the compass than the master. Because of that, he refers to the Hidden's master as the arakkoa Ssarbik's master.
The High Elf Refugees are high elves located in Shattrath City.
__NOTOC__ Hifa Moonstream is a night elf hunter located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.

__NOTOC__ High-Capacity Decoction Conduit was forged and constructed by Alard Schmied on the order and specifications from Deucus Valdera, using the following ingredients at Alard's Forge: *Eternity Sand *Sabelite Sulfate *Dragur Dust *Flask of the Seventh Demon *Nythendra's Heart Deucus then replaced his broken conduit with this new and stronger one in the Agronomical Apothecary in Dalaran.
The High Inquisitor's Lair is a section of Nath'raxas Hold where High Inquisitor Raalgar and Quartermistress Kl'azz reside. Several small Legion devastators are aligned here.

Heymanhoof Slope is a remote section of the cliffside located just north of Skyhorn in Highmountain. The location features two caves. One with an obvious entrance, and one hidden behind a bush to the right of the main entrance.

High Elf Wayfarers are high elves standing next to the Locus-Walker in Telogrus Rift alongside Silvermoon Scholars. Sometimes, a Wayfarer spawns from the Rift to Stormwind and walks to join the others next to the Locus-Walker. __NOTOC__
Hidden Cannons were sold for by Durkis and Zuna during Island Expeditions.
Hexxing Fetishes are totems created by Vilewing Screechers in Highmountain.

High Guard Reshef is a tol'vir located in Neferset City in Uldum.

Hidden Treasure Chest is a treasure chest located inside Killclaw's Lair in Exile's Reach. It was placed there by the ogres of the island so that Killclaw the Terrible could guard it—though, judging by the number of Ogre Shadowcaster corpses at the entrance to Killclaw's Lair, they had a very hard time getting the chest inside. They planned to kill Killclaw and retrieve the treasure after their rituals were finished.
High Guard Makag is an ogre located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.

Hibernal Hollow is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Glayn. It is the central grove at the heart of Tirna Glayn, overseen by Droman Aliothe. Some notable residents include the tree historian Shimmerfly, the envoy of the Court of Night Teendynneetll, Guardian Molan in charge of the Wild Hunt stationed here, and the artisan Craftmaster Fanda.
Hidden Legacies begins the patch 10.0.7 portion of the Dragonflight campaign, starting the Forbidden Reach storyline. The quest will be pushed to players automatically upon zoning into Valdrakken.

in Hearthstone.]] High priests are priestly practitioners and are mostly seen among troll priests, as exemplified by Mar'li, Thekal, Arlokk, Venoxis, and Jeklik from Zul'Gurub. They grant Hakkar the Soulflayer various abilities if they are not killed. The term is also associated with the kaldorei people and their priesthood called Sisterhood of Elune as high priestesses are its leaders. Draenei of the Aldor are also led by high priestess Ishanah. However, the title "high priest" can mean any person high ranked in a religious society who is a leader of lower-ranked priests. Notably, the Church of the Holy Light which has several high priests in its ranks. During the Burning Legion's third inv

High Priestess Jeklik is the High Priestess of the bat loa Hir'eek, Lord of the Midnight Sky. She is one of five High Priest encounters in Zul'Gurub, and is generally considered the first encounter of the instance. Until defeated, Jeklik empowers Hakkar with , allowing him to cast Sonic Burst.

Mar'li is the High Priestess of the spider loa, Shadra. She is one of five High Priest encounters in Zul'Gurub, and is generally considered the third encounter of the instance. Until defeated, Mar'li empowers Hakkar with , allowing him to occasionally stun his current target for 6 seconds. This effect also resets the target's threat.

__NOTOC__ High Marshal Whirlaxis is a wind serpent boss summoned at a Greater Windstone in Silithus. He is a powerful elemental being requiring 20-40 people to defeat. Summoning him requires a full Twilight Trappings set, a Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station, and a Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship.
The High Path is the rise leading up from Windyreed Village in Nagrand to Shattrath City above.
High Warlord's Mooncloth Vestments was a PvP reward, and could be purchased for from in Hall of Legends.
High Warlord Uro is a Forsaken that wanders the city of Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he had his axe in hands.

High Potency Radioactive Fallout is gathered from LIVING creatures in Gnomeregan that have a green glow about them by using the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial. Once gathered, the player has 2 real time hours in which to turn the quest in. Usually, there is sufficient time to complete the instance before turning the quest in, but this is dependent on the ability of the group.
__NOTOC__ High Ranger Valarian was, according to a plaque on his statue, a very handsome and powerful ranger who died a hero of Vashj'ir.

The High Road stretches from Hunter's Hill in the Southern Barrens to Malaka'Jin in Stonetalon Mountains and is the main route for Horde players on foot to cross from one zone to the next. In addition to access from Malaka'Jin and Hunter's Hill, an entrance marked by torches can be found at Stonetalon Pass, near the border with the Northern Barrens. This allows travelers to bypass the Alliance-held Honor's Stand, which would otherwise block access to the Southern Barrens. Nura Pathfinder stands along the road to make sure the nearby humans don't map out the road above them and prevent it's use by the Horde. She sends heroes of the Horde to kill any Alliance High Road Scout they come across.
High Prophet Barim is a boss in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

Highbank is the Alliance's main base of operations and harbor in the Twilight Highlands. Its Horde counterpart is Dragonmaw Port. Alliance players first arrive after Fargo Flintlocke gives you a ride to the Highlands in his flying machine and crashes at the town. When players wake up from the crash, the town is under attack by the Horde and is recaptured through phasing. The town is unfinished, with only the walls, guard towers and keep complete (something players have criticized when comparing to the Dragonmaw Port, which was captured, rebuilt, and fortified in less time than it took for the Alliance to get Highbank to the point it is at now). __NOTOC__ High Warlock Xi'lun is an orc warlock who is in charge of Dreadmaul Rock. He is the mastermind behind a plan that will wipe out both the Alliance and the Horde in the Burning Steppes and assure the Blackrock clan's conquest of the Redridge Mountains.
Highborne Charlatans are night elf ghosts found at the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains.
Highborne Citizens are night elf ghosts found at the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains.
Highborne Lasses are night elf ghosts found at the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains.
Highborne Sorcerers are night elf ghosts found at the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains.
High Priest Sekhemet is a level 85 Tol'vir at Neferset City, Uldum.
High Warlord Shoju is a Forsaken fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.

The High Priestess' Reliquary is found near Malfurion Stormrage and Tyrande Whisperwind at on the upper floor of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The reliquary contains Music Roll: Shalandis Isle for players who have completed Bringing the Bass. The strongbox can be looted by both Alliance and Horde players, though Horde players may want to take a raid.
High Sage Zelkyr was the predecessor of High Sage Viryx. He possessed the ability to see through the eyes of kaliri.
__NOTOC__ High Mages of the Duskwatch are nightborne found in the city of Suramar.

__NOTOC__ High Vindicators are draenei vindicators who first appeared during the Battle for the Exodar. They appear in trios with the Lightsworn Anchorites, placing a war banner after the fel portals are destroyed. They appeared before the departure to Argus, leading Exodar Vindicator in drills. Several of them serves as the vanguard of the Vindicaar during Alone in the Abyss. Later a High Vindicator appeared in Dalaran standing next to the Lightforged beacon at Krasus' Landing, and guarding the Exodar's vicinity and on Argus.

Higher Dimensional Learning is a Legion exploration achievement obtained by reading all seven chapters of the "Beginner's Guide to Dimensional Rifting" in Azsuna. Beginner's Guide to Dimensional Rifting is required in order to interact with the books, as well as to get to some places that currently cannot be reached due to player flight being disabled.

Highborne Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Highborne archaeology sites.

__NOTOC__ High Wakener Aargon is an eredar echo located at the Conservatory of the Arcane in Eredath. As one of Archimonde's greatest pupils, Aargon held such power in his own disciplines that the Conservatory remembers him even centuries later. He must be defeated in order in order for Army of the Light to advance their quest to obtain the Sigil of Awakening.
The Highborne Memento drops from Thelar Moonstrike and Commander Drald in Darkshore.
High Priests of Silvermoon are blood elves located in the Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for Lordaeron.
High Society Entertainer is a nightborne harpist located in the Midnight Court of Suramar City in Suramar. Loyalist Sycophants spectate her.
High Prophet Massas is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.
High Shaman Claxikar is a makrura located in Island Expeditions.
High Priest's Cypher is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Invocation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Mythos is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Gift is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Legacy is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Ultimatum is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
High Priest's Lesson is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Highland Drake is dragonriding mount that is a quest reward from Calling the Blue Dragons. Obtaining this mount rewards the An Azure Ally. Additional customization can be unlocked by the drakewatcher manuscripts from various Dragonflight sources while the drake can be customized at a Rostrum of Transformation.
Hiji is a small island in the South Seas, to the east of Kezan, south of the Broken Isles and the Maelstrom, and southwest of Stranglethorn Vale.
Highmountain Tribe Insignia is rewarded from Class Hall missions.
Highmist Terrace is a terrace between two waterfalls in the Moon Guard Stronghold of Suramar.
The Highmountain Tribes Vendor List was sold by Xur'ios in Dalaran for .
Highmountain Spring Water is a drink item sold by vendors throughout the Broken Isles for .
Highmountain Tiswin is sold by bartenders throughout the Broken Isles.
Hillevi the Scalekeeper is a vrykul flight master located at Stormtorn Foothills in Stormheim.
The Highmountain Thunderhoof is a reward from Together We Are the Horde!
Highperch Soarers are wyverns seen flying above Highperch in Thousand Needles.
The Highmountain Trueshot Cape is a quest reward from Huln's War - The Nathrezim.
The Highmountain Signet Ring was a quest reward from Huln's War - The Nathrezim.
The Highwind Darkmane is a larion flying mount rewarded from Campaign: War-Captain's Woe.

Highlord's Invocation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Highlord's Mythos is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Highlord's Ultimatum is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Highly-Polished Handmirror is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Highland Fishing becomes available at Renown level 6 with the Iskaara Tuskarr. This quest has no rewards; it exists only to direct you to Tavio, who can craft you a Flying Fish Bone Charm.

Highland Drake: Embodiment of the Hellforged has a very low drop chance from Scalecommander Sarkareth in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Raid Finder, Normal, and Heroic difficulties. Mythic difficulty has a guarantee drop for two manuscripts until the end of the Dragonflight expansion.

The Hillsbrad Foothills (sometimes referred to as simply Hillsbrad) is a mid-level zone most suitable for players around level 25. Located in the Southern end of the North Island of (Eastern Kingdoms), the hills are home to the towns of Southshore and Hillsbrad Fields (Alliance), and Tarren Mill (Horde). Some notable locations, such as Durnholde Keep and Azurelode Mine can also be found here. Since this area lies outside of Thoradin's Wall, it is considered as a crossroads between Alliance and Horde players, which makes combat between the two factions likely. Hillsbrad is relatively safe and stable. Its hills are green and pastoral, its meadows fertile and its soil rich. Humans loyal to the

Hobgoblins, sometimes known simply as brutes, oafs, or mooks, are large, mutated goblins most commonly found guarding goblin settlements, acting as bodyguards or even serving as mounts. They were once regular goblins, but have been altered by some foul alchemy to become tough, powerful, and "dumber than an ogre with a hangover". The sweat of hobgoblins is considered acidic. They are shown to be affected by kaja'mite just like normal goblins. According to Sky Admiral Rogers, the Dominance Offensive brought in Heavy Mooks in order to hide behind their bodies during the battles in the Krasarang Wilds. Hobgoblins made their first appearance in World of Warcraft with the Cataclysm expansion.

__NOTOC__ Hin Denburg is a goblin zeppelin master located in the zeppelin tower just north of the Undercity gates, in the Forsaken starting zone of Tirisfal Glades. He gives information about Grom'Gol Base Camp.
The Hoard of the Black Dragonflight is a quest reward from Trinkets....

The Hoard is located inside the Scarlet Bastion, past the Hall of Lights, in the perpetually burning city of Stratholme. It is where the Crimson Legion keeps their stash of weaponry, and is presided over by Cannon Master Willey. This area dead-ends with a row of cannons, which must be used to defeat waves of angry mobs.

This is a questing guide detailing the best method to obtain and complete quests in Hillsbrad Foothills. For a list of all Hillsbrad Foothills quests in table format (arranged by level), see Hillsbrad Foothills quests Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Hodir is a titanic watcher who resides in Ulduar. He once resided in the Temple of Winter, lending his guidance to the frost giants in the Storm Peaks. The Sons of Hodir, a faction in the region, refer to Hodir as a father figure or creator. It was announced on Feb 17, 2009 that Hodir would be a raid encounter in the then-upcoming Ulduar raid dungeon. After being defeated, Hodir is redeemed and teleports away to optionally help the players against Yogg-Saron later.

__NOTOC__ Hillsbrad Worgen were Hillsbrad Refugees (former residents of Southshore and Hillsbrad Fields) that fled to Fenris Isle after the Forsaken attacked their towns. Realizing that the Forsaken will never stop hunting them until they become servants to the undead whether in life or death, they decided to take the offer of blood by Darius Crowley. Thus they became worgen, to have the power to have their vengeance, and also so that the val'kyr would not be able to raise them as Forsaken after their death. Hillsbrad Refugees are former residents of Southshore and Hillsbrad Fields that fled to Fenris Isle after the Forsaken attacked their towns. Agatha and Horde adventurers, on the orders of Sylvanas Windrunner, pursued them there and raised some of them into undeath. Realizing that the Forsaken would never stop hunting them until they become servants to the undead whether in life or death, they and their leaders decided to take the offer of blood by Darius Crowley. Thus they became the Hillsbrad Worgen, to have the power to have their vengeance and attempt to retake Lordaeron for the Alliance, and so that the val'kyr would not be able to raise them as Forsaken after their death. Historian Winterfur is a pandaren in the Chamber of Enlightenment in the Shrine of Seven Stars. A K'thir Darkspeaker has disguised itself as him in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Historian Jenji is a pandaren found in the Chamber of Enlightenment in the Shrine of Seven Stars. A K'thir Darkspeaker has disguised itself as her in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Hiss is an ability that can be used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Hizzle is a goblin flight master located at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Hixin was one of Warlord Gurthan's advisers. He used a parchment written by the Warlord that was never sent in order to trick his rival Taskmaster Xuexing into going using a tested weapon against the mantid earlier than intended. When the Taskmaster died in the battle Hixin tried to play it off as the Xuexing becoming overconfident in his abilities, however, he fell silent when the Warlord pulled out the parchment used in the deception. When Hixin tried to plead his case, Warlord Gurthan did not hesitate to order his quilen to kill his former adviser.

__NOTOC__ Hippogryph Archers are night elves located in Nazj'vel and the Twilight Vale between the wisp wall and Blackwood Den in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. Two archers accompanied Captain Delaryn Summermoon to Nazj'vel in order to find the source of Onu's pain. The ones stationed at Darnassus were rallied into defense of Darkshore as well. During the final phase, they were attacked by the Horde army at Mist's Edge next to Lor'danel.
Hippogryph Lord Varah is an undead night elf located at the Terrace of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Hol'wud the Wingman is an orc flight master that appeared in the Frostwall garrison in the early beta before being replaced by Bron Skyhorn.
Hisskarath is a snake that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Hjana Fogbringer is a kvaldir who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Hivemind is an encounter in Ny'alotha, the Waking City in which Ka'zir and Tek'ris are fought.

The Hive is an aqir-infested temple in the western part of Ny'alotha, the Waking City. The Hivemind rule the aqir from the temple's center, while Ra-den the Despoiled resides on the Terrace of Desolation at its apex.
Hippogryph Feather was a quest reward from I Believe I Can Fly!.
Hive Guardian Ksh'ix is a beetle located in Island Expeditions.
Hive Guardian Yx'nil is a beetle located in Island Expeditions.
Hit Scheme is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Historical Perspective Shifters are cosmetic eyeglasses in the head slot sold for by Finn in outside the Barber Shop in the Trade District of Stormwind City or Ca'nees in the Barber Shop of Orgrimmar.
Histar's Severe Stiletto is a world drop from Shadowlands mobs.
Hired Tidesages are humans located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Hjorik is a red dragonspawn flight master located at Apex Observatory in the Waking Shores.

Holy Light is a paladin ability, learned automatically at level 1. It is designed to be the Holy Paladin's efficient heal. It has higher HPM than either Divine Light or Flash of Light, but is considerably weaker than either of those spells.

If they ran into trouble, they had to take care of themselves, either talking their way out of things, fighting their way out, or simply running and hiding. The holy strider tapped into the world's readily available energy and began harnessing that magic to aid their travels. Now, although the tauren have their own well-fortified homeland and capital, the holy striders still find themselves in high demand as messengers, diplomats, spies and explorers. Holy Guidance is a talent that adds a certain percentage of the Paladin's Intellect to his spell power.

Homeward Bound is a Horde quest in which the player must escort the tauren Pao'ka Swiftmountain past the wyverns of Highperch to safety. NOTE: You may want to do Wind Rider (quest) along with this quest, as it also takes place in Highperch. Pick it up from Elu at Freewind Post.

When the green torch burns outside the Guildhall, its Field Instructor Hona Stonefall helps determine which dwarves will make up the next generation of prospectors. She's notorious for leading groups of candidates into the mountains and within a day convincing all but the brightest and toughest that they should try an easier profession, like defusing goblin land mines. Yet those who persevere and are trained to become prospectors by Hona are among the most famous members of the Guild.

Holy resistance does not currently exist as a visible or collectible statistic in World of Warcraft. It only exists against PvE targets of a higher level. The sole means to prevent holy damage are limited to effects that affect all spells, eg reduction effects such as Major Holy Protection Potion. Fortunately, Holy damage is not common. Only Paladins and Priests wield these magics in a slim arsenal, and boss encounters featuring heavy Holy damage are rare: the is a remarkable case, with being a much less dangerous second.
Holiday Snow is found in the Alterac Mountains area of Hillsbrad Foothills, across Dun Morogh, Winterspring, and small portion of western Loch Modan during the Feast of Winter Veil event.

:With just a dash of sweetness, these crunchy "lichen" crisps are a tasty way to enjoy daily greens. Often peddled by fungus vendors, these highly nutritious snacks of the Undercity undead are now easy to make yourself.
Holy Radiance is a Holy paladin ability learned at level 28.

Honor Points are the lower-level currency rewarded for participating in PvP encounters in the form of battlegrounds and Honorable Kills. The upper-level PvP currency, gained from rated battlegrounds and arena matches, is awarded in the form of Conquest Points. The cap for Honor Points is 4000. As of patch 4.0.6, the PvP rewards requiring level 70 and below are quite cheap, and battlegrounds can be an effective means of gearing up, even for players who do not focus on PvP. The level 80 items have been discounted by 25-40%. Holy Word: Chastise is a Holy priest Holy Word ability. It is an instant-cast damage spell that disorients its target.
Holy Word: Sanctuary is a priest Holy Word, a Holy specialization ability. It is an area of effect smart-healing spell, gained through the Chakra: Sanctuary state, replacing Holy Word: Chastise.

The Hole is an abandoned cellblock in the southwestern part of Tol Barad. Reports have come that it is overrun with prisoners that have been stuck down there for years. Warden Silva, located within the Warden's Chambers, is the master of the prisoners and they will do anything for him. He holds keys that would allow those controlling the island to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply on Tol Barad. The cellblock also holds rations, remaining from years of use, which are wanted by both the Horde and Alliance to renew their own supplies. The Hole is located to the southwest of Baradin Hold, just east of Warden's Vigil.
Homurk is an orc of the Blackrock clan who oversees the worg kennel at Alther's Mill in the Redridge Mountains.

Honor's Stand Peasants are the human peasants who are working to build the Alliance fortifications at the recently captured Honor's Stand. They can be found both working on the towers, particularly the southern one where Tower Wardens stand nearby, as well as carrying lumber from the nearby border with Stonetalon Mountains.
Holy Avenger is a paladin class talent. When this ability is active, the Paladin's weapon uses the Ashbringer model.

Holding Hands is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for destroying the final Crystal Conductor during Hagara's lightning phase on Normal or Heroic difficulty while all raid members are part of the final Lightning Conduit.
Holy Prism is a Holy paladin talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Light's Hammer (paladin ability).
Holy Insight is a passive ability for Holy paladins. It is learned at level 10.
Holy Charge is an ability used by Mini Tyrael during a Pet Battle.
Holy Justice is an ability used by Mini Tyrael during a Pet Battle.

Honest Jim is the Alliance aligned smuggler whose services adventurers acquire if they choose to construct the Smuggler's Den at Southport in Spires of Arak. Every ten minutes, players with the Smuggling Den are able to summon him using the Smuggling Run! ability. He functions as a merchant, offering various items that offer beneficial buffs in the Spires of Arak, healing potions, and some other useful stock. His stock is randomized, and changes each time he is summoned.

__NOTOC__ Hono Galehoof is a Highmountain tauren vendor located at Talonrest in Stormheim. He and Ootasa Galehoof were murdered by Rax Sixtrigger and Snaggle Sixtrigger while an adventurer was off killing duskpelt worgs.
Holy Word: Sanctify is a priest talent. It is one of the Holy Word abilities available to a Holy priest.

Homeless Stormwind Citizens are homeless people located in various locations around Westfall. They were displaced from Stormwind City. During the Legion Invasions, they could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.

Honor Hold Recons are humans and dwarves located in the three sections of Hellfire Citadel. While they are stealthing in Hellfire Ramparts and the Blood Furnace, they are found dead in the Shattered Halls.
-holme is a Common suffix for calling a city: *Deatholme *Scourgeholme *Stratholme
Honey Bees are bees located along the roads in the Tidebreak Foothills in Stormsong Valley. Other briefly appear after using Declan's Potion of Plant Shape during Learn From the Best (Alliance).
Honor Hold Archers are humans located in Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula. They also appear inside the Shattered Halls.
The Honor Hold Mage is a human located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City.
The Honeyback Harvester's Harness is a bee flying mount rewarded from Leaving the Hive.
Honey and Sausage Mash is sold by Felicity Noel and Sanya Wraithschilde in Stormsong Valley and by Geldrin in the Arathi Highlands.

Homing Copters are gnomish copters located at Hook Point in Boralus. They are part of the shipping operation of Serafim Springwheel and Chance Cogswaddle. They are used to ship all manner of goods, like honey, mead, live crabs as well as other odds and ends. Piston Throttlebin is the inventor of the copters. One was sent with Mekkatorque's Escape Pod to Mechagon Island.
The Holy Relic drops from M'uru in Sunwell Plateau. This item only drops for vulpera adventurers and will add a new cyclable ability to the Bag of Tricks (racial) racial.
Hollow Widow is a nerubian spider located in Skittering Hollow during Island Expeditions.
Hollow Bones is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Holyfire Draught is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Holy Hellstone is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Holy Avenger's Engraved Sigil is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Holy Sigil.
__NOTOC__ Honmor is a mountain giant located in the Waking Shores during Grand Hunt.
Honorguard Chestpiece is a quest reward from Venom to the Undercity.
Honored by Your Allies is the reward quest for reaching reputation with the Shattered Sun Offensive.
Hoof is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Jinxed Hoodoo Piles could be found around Zul'Gurub.]] Hoodoo is a form of magic used by trolls. Zanza the Restless, a loa of the Zandalar tribe, was particularly skilled in enchanting items via hoodoo, with the right reagents.
__NOTOC__ Honorbound Scouting Map is a map that unlocks flight points in Zandalar and Kul Tiras for every Horde character on an account.
The Hook Charm Necklace drops from Thruk in the Moonshrine Ruins in Blackfathom Deeps.
Honorbound Conquerors are orcs attacking Maiev Shadowsong and Shandris Feathermoon near the Ruins of Auberdine and Bashal'Aran in Darkshore, which results in their death.

Hope's Ascent is what's left of a mountain on the western side of the mainland of Korthia. The area is bordered to the north by the Maw border, the northeast by the Mauler's Outlook, the east by the unnamed central crossroads, the south by the Estuary of Awakening, and the west by the edge of the zone.
Hood of Star Topology drops from Tethos southwest of the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis.

Horns of the Illidari are a quest reward from Subdue the Subduer which begins with Illidari Lord Balthas on the Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley. You must be with Netherwing to receive this quest.

A Horde Gift Collection is a collection of the three Horde city Gift Collections, and is the third and final hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Horde NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. __NOTOC__

__NOTOC__ Horace Alder is a human mage trainer located on the top floor of Jaina's Tower on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. If he seems distracted it's cause he fears for the men of Northwatch, and wished he had sent some of his students to aid them. Horace Alder was part of the human forces in the Stonetalon Mountains during the Third War. His base was attacked by the Warsong clan led by Grommash Hellscream. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Horatio M. Montgomery was a doctor or healer of some kind. A statue named Horatio Montgomery, M.D. has been erected in his memory in the SI:7 area within the Old Town section of Stormwind City. He was about 75 years old at the time of his death.

__NOTOC__ The Horde Keep is situated at the northern end of the Isle of Conquest, just to the east of the Refinery and directly north of the Alliance Keep. Overlord Agmar can be found within the command room of the Keep with four Kor'kron Guards. The Keep Graveyard capture flag is located at the northeast corner of the courtyard. Capturing this graveyard can delay Horde defenders significantly, while providing Alliance attackers with a much closer graveyard to the Overlord. Both the Overlord and Keep Graveyard flag are unavailable until at least one of the three Keep Gates have been destroyed.

The Horde Valiants' Ring is an octagonal ring outside the Sunreaver Pavilion where many aspiring horde valiants come to challenge the faction city valiants in a battle duel. Alliance players also come here to easily complete .
Channels the Cloud ability, which stops an area of enemy towers from attacking for 30 seconds.
Horn Toss is one of the pet abilities that only rhinos can use. It knocks back a melee target 15 yards.

Horde Infantry are orcish members of the Horde army in Silverwind Refuge, Ashenvale, awaiting deployment to Stonetalon Mountains. Before leaving on the caravans they listen to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain give a speech about their assignment. They are eager to join the front lines of battle.
Horde Enforcers are orc and tauren soldiers of the Horde found at the Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore.
Horn Attack is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

The Horde Landing Site is the name of the large Southern Island in Krasarang Wilds when the Horde begin to arrive a couple of months after the initial insertion by the Horde adventurers. The Horde, however, receive a warm welcome by the Alliance who have also arrived nearby and begin assaulting the Horde in order to prevent them from taking any land. The Alliance fails as the Horde hero clears them out and signals for the fleet.

Horridon is the second boss encounter in the Throne of Thunder. It is a giant direhorn empowered by the Zandalari Beast Ward as an instrument of war, similar to Oondasta. The battle consists of battling the various troll tribes of Azeroth as much as the boss.
Horn Gore is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Horde Prisoners are orcs found on the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.

The Horde of Agony were led by Maim, who served under the Master of Pain. The Horde of Agony was tasked with protecting and securing Magtheridon's Black Temple against any enemy who would attack the Lord of Outland. When the Illidari invaded in order to remove the pit lord from power, the Horde of Agony was defeated with both Maim and their master killed. It is assumed that any surviving fel orcs eventually joined the Fel Horde under Warchief Kargath Bladefist.

The Horde of Pain was led by Rend, who served under the Master of Pain. The Horde of Pain was tasked with protecting and securing Magtheridon's Black Temple against any enemy who would attack the Lord of Outland. When the Illidari invaded in order to remove the pit lord from power, the Horde of Pain was defeated with both Rend and their master killed. It is assumed that any surviving fel orcs eventually joined the Fel Horde under Warchief Kargath Bladefist.
__NOTOC__ Horkus is a mo'arg brute disguised as an ogre located in Shackle's Den in Azsuna. He can be exposed by paladins wielding the Truthguard or by abilities to reveal demons.
Horde Demolitionists were orcs riding demolishers in front of the Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for the Undercity.
Horde Conscripts were tauren located in the Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Horde Vanguard Spectators are tauren and Highmountain tauren located at the Mugambala in Zuldazar.
Horde Peacekeepers are tauren and pandaren guards located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

__NOTOC__ Horde Emissaries are blood elves, tauren, and orcs located in Warport Rastari in Zuldazar during the Alliance War Campaign. Some of them can be seen healing Injured Bladeguards with the Light. On Shandris Feathermoon's orders, they are sent by the Alliance champion into a void rift.
The Horrific Iris is a gate found within the Maw of Gor'ma in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It leads to the Spawning Pit.

The Horde Council is the ruling body of the Horde. The council members each hold a position of power over the Horde; acting in the place of the retired position of Warchief. Each is considered a representative of their people, if not the racial leader in some cases.
__NOTOC__ Horko is a hozen located in Un'gol Ruins during Island Expeditions.

Horde Timber Lords are orc lumberjacks summoned in 's areas by the commander to cut down Timbers for Frostwall's lumber mill. They come down from a copter and after briefly working on the tree, they quickly despawn.
Horrific Hemorrhages are located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Horgul, Hound of Darkness is a shadehound located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. It is summoned through the Chain of Command (anima power) during Torghast: Beasts of Prodigum.
Horrific Dictionary is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Horrid Dredwing is a dredbat flying mount that rarely drops from Harika the Horrid in the Banewood in Revendreth. It can also be purchased from Chachi the Artiste in Sinfall for .
__NOTOC__ Hornswog Hunks are a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking. They drop from hornswogs in the Dragon Isles.
Horned Flysnatchers are hornswogs located in Misty Vale in Thaldraszus.

.]] A house cat is a small type of feline that is seen around some NPCs and most of which can be purchased as companions from Donni Anthania in the Elwynn Forest. One type can be purchased from Lil Timmy in Stormwind City. After centuries of domestication, these furry critters inhabit nearly every human nation in the Eastern Kingdoms. The souls of all cats are sent to Revendreth after death, though there is apparently at least one exception to this rule. Occasionally, house cats are named mobs, for example Mr. Bigglesworth and Salome. As of patch 5.0.4, all house cats meow when clicked.

Howling Ziggurat is a ziggurat just east of the Dead Scar in central Ghostlands. The area around the ziggurat is patrolled by Stonewing Trackers. Inside the ziggurat three Deatholme Darkmages guard Stone of Light - an ancient artifact imbued with power of Sunwell. Adventurers are tasked to retrieve the Stone in order to use it against the Scourge in the area.

A hotkey is a key on the keyboard which activates something within a system. Specific to World of Warcraft, a hotkey activates abilities or skills, opens panes, begins or ends automatic actions, or, in general, performs whatever it has been scripted to do. 'Binding' and 'keybinding' are equivalent terms.
__NOTOC__ Howling Blast is a Frost death Knight ability that allows the death knight to blast several targets around them for frost damage, and applies Frost Fever to multiple targets.
Hotawa is a tuskarr located on the big island in the middle of the Njord's Breath Bay in the Borean Tundra. He stands next to Elder Muahit.
Howlin' Good Moonshine is sold by Hugh Glass at Redwood Trading Post in the Grizzly Hills.

The Howling Oak was an area in the north of the night elven capital city of Darnassus, centered around large Gilnean oak tree. It was the new home of the refugees who fled Gilneas with the aid of the night elves following the Forsaken invasion. The tree itself is a "worgen tree", very similar to Tal'doren in the Blackwald. The area is accessible from the Craftsmen's Terrace and Cenarion Enclave from the southeast and southwest respectively. The Howling Oak was originally grown through the aid of the night elven druids from a seed taken from Gilneas. It now stands for all the Gilneans have endured since the ruin of their kingdom, and all that their people have since accomplished. King Genn Gr
Houndmaster Jonathan is a level 30 Gilnean human quest giver at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

Horrify effects or horror effects are a form of crowd control. Horrify effects may root the target or cause them to run in a random direction, but all prevent the target from taking most actions for the duration. Horrify effects are magical debuffs, and can therefore be dispelled. Horrify effects in the Shadow school can also be resisted. Horrify effects are subject to diminishing returns.
Howl is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Howling Hills is an area in eastern Highmountain controlled by packs of wolves.
Houndmaster Payne is a felguard disguised as a worgen located in Greywatch in Stormheim. He can be exposed by paladins wielding the Truthguard or by abilities to reveal demons.
Household Vigilants are vigilants located in Arinor Gardens in Eredath. They can be activated with a Vigilant Power Crystal, and will act as guardians for a brief time.
Houndmaster Survok is a Highmountain tauren who bred demonic hounds to serve as guardians.

__NOTOC__ Horrified Echoes are echoes of frightened eredar located at Triumvirate's End in Eredath, forever remembering the day of the flight of the draenei. Some of them are devoured by Soultwisted Echoes.

House Astravar is a noble house residing in the nightborne capital of Suramar. Led by Lady Aurore Astravar, the house is one of the more influential of those within shal'dorei society, based from their Gilded Market mansion in the city's noble quarter. The Astravars have remained close political and personal allies of House Lunastre, making them one of the few noble houses sympathetic to the rebel cause during the Nightfallen rebellion.
Hosan Cloudhoof is a Highmountain tauren located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.

The Howling Crag pale is a group of pale orcs that dwell at the Howling Crag in the Spires of Arak. They live in caves underneath a rylak breeding ground. Unlike the other pale who seem to simply dwell underground and be an occasional nuisance to the locals, these pale appear to have a form of community where each learn a form of magic.
Horvuld Oceanscythe is a vrykul located on the expedition isles.
Houndmaster Angvold is a vargul who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Howling Snowdrift Loop is a quest reward from WANTED: Gutsmash the Destroyer.
The Howling Isles are a small group of islands in Stormsong Valley, found due south of the Shrine of the Storm's main isle.
Hosvir of the Rotting Hull is a kvaldir located in Island Expeditions.

The House of Plagues is one of the five houses that rule Maldraxxus, the crafters of toxins and potions. Its seat was destroyed at some point before the events of Shadowlands, after the anima draught began, after they were approached by a lich of the House of Rituals (who may have been responsible for the explosion that caused their fall), and before Margrave Stradama was to send a letter to someone discussing what had happened to the Primus. The House is currently struggling to survive. Of those who survived the fall of the house, many ended up being taken by the plagues released. The Hound of Gazzran is a core hound located in Island Expeditions.
Howling Soulcore is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hourglass of Soul Dust is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hover Disks are flying discs found in the Eye of Eternity. They are used by Scions of Eternity and Nexus Lords and can be mounted once their owners have been dealt with.
Human Commoners show up only during Holiday events inside Stormwind City and Dalaran. They usually show up in pairs.
Hunger for Blood is a rogue ability introduced in patch 3.0.2. It provides rogues with a large damage buff to their attacks provided that one bleed effect is on their target.
Huddle is one of the abilities that is available to Unholy Death Knight Ghoul pets. It is affected by Dark Transformation.

__NOTOC__ Hugh Glass is a human trapper and vendor located at Redwood Trading Post in the Grizzly Hills with his bear companion Griselda. He's "not right in the head" and claims to have escaped from the Wolfcult, though his friends Limpy Joe and Flannel McGee weren't as lucky. Hugh initially mistakes adventurers for Limpy Joe and asks them to find some fish for Griselda. When they return, he changes his mind and instead accuses them of being Joe's murderer, then threatens them into leaving. __NOTOC__ The Humboldt Conflagration is an area of the Twilight Highlands, located in a small valley between Glopgut's Hollow and the Ruins of Drakgor, and northwest of Thundermar. This was the site of the former Wildhammer settlement of Humboldt's Stead. During the years, Humboldt's Stead's worst problems were caused by the Glopgut ogres up on the nearby ridge. Then the Twilight's Hammer came and in an instant set the whole valley ablaze destroying the settlement and its surroundings, tough survivors manage to escape. The town was overrun by unbound fire elementals led by an elemental ascendant known as Magmalord Falthazar.

Human Seedlings are the unfortunate survivors of Hillsbrad Fields who are now buried in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills, awaiting harvest. The and s will occasionally leap across the field and feast upon one of these unfortunate victims with an ability called "Eat Face". When the player encounters this grim situation, they are compelled to "do the right thing" and help the seedlings, either by bashing their head with a shovel or pulling them out of the dirt.
Huge Fang is an ability used several pets during a Pet Battle. The damage increase persists through pet swaps.
Hugeclaw is a rare crab that can be found on one of the islands in Dustwallow Bay in Dustwallow Marsh.
